CVE-2026-116723.title: FLTK through 1.4.5 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnera ...
CVE-2026-116723.description: FLTK through 1.4.5 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in Fl_BMP_Image::load_bmp_() that allows attackers to corrupt stack memory by supplying an oversized BMP colors_used field. Attackers can craft BMP or ICO files with colors_used above 256 to overflow the 768-byte colormap array, causing crashes or potential code execution.

CVE-2026-116724.title: FLTK through 1.4.5 contains an integer overflow vulnerability in  ...
CVE-2026-116724.description: FLTK through 1.4.5 contains an integer overflow vulnerability in Fl_BMP_Image::load_bmp_() that causes undersized pixel buffer allocation from file-supplied width and height. Attackers can supply a crafted BMP or ICO file with large dimensions so row decoding writes file-derived data past the heap buffer, corrupting the application heap.
